samples.text:
The table shows the results of a survey about how many guests was satisfied with five different aspects of their stay at three hotels.

Hotel Aurora got very good results for room cleanliness with 94%, which is the highest in the table, and location with 90%. Staff friendliness was 86% and food quality was 78%. But only 61% of guests thought that it was a good value for money.

Harbour Inn was the best hotel for staff friendliness, 90% of guests were satisfied. It also have the highest score for value for money, 88%. Room cleanliness was 81% and location was 74%. However, the food quality was not so good, only 65%.

Parkside Lodge had the best food with 84% and good cleanliness with 88%. Value for money was 79%. On the other hand, staff friendliness was 72% and location was only 55%, this was the lowest result of all.

Overall, each hotel was good in some aspects and bad in others, and Hotel Aurora seem to have the best results in general.
samples.why: All figures accurate and each hotel covered · overview basic and at the end · hotel-by-hotel listing limits comparison · simple, repetitive vocabulary · several agreement errors and comma splices that do not block meaning.

samples.text:
The table presents the findings of a survey in which guests at three hotels were asked about their satisfaction with five aspects of their stay.

Overall, each hotel had its own strengths and weaknesses, and no single hotel performed best in every category. Hotel Aurora received the highest ratings in two areas, while Parkside Lodge had the lowest score of all for its location.

Hotel Aurora was rated most highly for room cleanliness, with 94% of guests satisfied, and for location, at 90%. Its staff were also well regarded (86%). However, only 61% felt that it offered value for money, which was the weakest result for this hotel and the lowest in that category.

Harbour Inn, by contrast, performed best in terms of value for money and staff friendliness, with satisfaction levels of 88% and 90% respectively. Its main weakness was food quality, which only 65% of guests were happy with. Parkside Lodge had the most positive rating for food, at 84%, and scored well for cleanliness (88%). Nevertheless, its staff received a less favourable rating of 72%, and just over half of its guests were satisfied with its location, which was 55%.
samples.why: Clear overview of contrasting strengths · key features for each hotel highlighted and compared · good range of linking (by contrast, nevertheless) · appropriate vocabulary · minor redundancy but mostly error-free.

samples.text:
The table summarises the results of a survey in which guests at Hotel Aurora, Harbour Inn and Parkside Lodge indicated whether they were satisfied with five aspects of their stay.

Overall, satisfaction levels were generally high, but each hotel displayed a distinctive profile of strengths and weaknesses. Hotel Aurora excelled in cleanliness and location, Harbour Inn in value for money and staff, and Parkside Lodge in food, while the single poorest rating was for Parkside's location.

Hotel Aurora achieved the highest figures in the table for room cleanliness (94%) and location (90%), and its staff were also well regarded, with 86% of guests satisfied. Its clear weak point, however, was value for money: only 61% were satisfied, the lowest result in this category and 27 points below Harbour Inn.

Harbour Inn's guests were the most positive about staff friendliness (90%) and value (88%), yet food quality received the lowest rating of the three hotels, at 65%. Parkside Lodge, by contrast, led the way for food, with 84% satisfied, and also scored well for cleanliness (88%). Its staff, though, drew a comparatively modest 72%, and its location was the least popular aspect across all three hotels, satisfying barely more than half of guests (55%).
samples.why: Concise overview identifying each hotel's strength · figures selected skilfully with apt derived gap · cohesion smooth and varied · precise, idiomatic vocabulary (excelled, weak point) · wide range of accurate structures.
